szoveg_eredeti:
Accurate weather forecasting starts with how clearly we can observe the atmosphere in real-time. 🌍

We're sharing two live datasets behind WeatherNext 3, enabling anyone to build their own weather and climate applications:

🌧️ PARDIG: Estimates global precipitation every 15 minutes, improving detection skill by more than 30% and helping WeatherNext 3 deliver more accurate precipitation forecasts.
🛰️ SatWeave: Combines several geostationary satellites into one live view of Earth’s clouds and storms every 60 minutes, which helped our AI model address the 6-hour lag of traditional simulations.

Together, these make it easier for teams to tackle real-world problems -  from issuing more accurate flood warnings in regions without ground radar to tracking wildfire smoke and solar energy.

Explore the historical archives and live data on Google Cloud Storage and Google Earth Engine →  https://goo.gle/4Au8qEx
